 Rochester Pride announces date for 2027 festival
 By KAALTV 
 --> 
 (ABC 6 News) — Rochester Pride announced their festival will take place on May 22, 2027 at Soldier’s Field Park. 
 The organization said they would also be extending their hours, from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., and would be expanding the physical space of their festival to have a secondary stage geared toward educational content and space for more vendors. 
 Vendor pricing will also be adjusted, to make the festival more affordable for small businesses and local artists.
